title: WfGg Radar operational discovery and controlled runtime evolution
problem: Prevent Autopilot HISTORY_QUALITY_FAILED on large Collector histories by avoiding full-history reconstruction for each seed, while preserving V6.19.8 cycle terminalization, V6.19.7 stale recovery, V6.19.6 no-data continuation and all blocking safety guards.
goals: Reuse historical 9/9 evidence only for the current @federated seed instead of reconstructing every historical Collector cycle.
Select candidate cycles from the small cycles table using SUCCESS, empty error and exact @federated:<seed> quality criteria before reading large history tables.
Scan cycle_seen, cycle_baseline and cycle_changes only for candidate cycle IDs and keep the lookup strictly SQLite read-only.
Preserve V6.17 quality semantics: failed/partial cycles are excluded and a targeted cycle must contain its own requested server in hash-verified historical state.
Preserve V6.19.8 verified Collector cycle terminalization.
Preserve V6.19.7 stale RUNNING cycle recovery.
Preserve V6.19.6 no-data retry/skip/continue behavior and valid 9/9 evidence.
Keep AUTH / NETWORK / CONNECTOR / SYSTEM and infrastructure failures blocking.
non_goals: Do not add or rebuild SQLite indexes as part of V6.19.9.
Do not mutate Collector history while looking up reusable evidence.
Do not weaken the 90-second historical evidence guard.
Do not reinterpret partial or failed cycles as full evidence.
Do not change the V6.19.5 12-hour sliding session policy.
Do not execute a Last War scan during the guard-only pilot probe.

current_change.purpose: Replace O(history × table-size) Autopilot history reconstruction with seed-targeted quality lookup so large Collector histories stay within the existing 90-second guard.

acceptance_criteria: The connector reports Autopilot version v6.19.9.
Historical evidence lookup first selects SUCCESS cycles with empty error and exact @federated:<seed> query.
Large history tables are read only for candidate cycle IDs rather than rebuilding every historical cycle.
SQLite history lookup uses mode=ro and PRAGMA query_only=ON.
V6.17 quality semantics remain enforced, including target-server presence in hash-verified historical state.
V6.19.8 Collector cycle terminalization remains present.
V6.19.6 AUTOPILOT_NO_DATA and SEED_SKIPPED_NO_DATA remain present.
Pilot installation is SHA-pinned, rollback-capable and guard-probed without a Last War scan or Collector mutation.
Production promotion requires a separate explicit human approval.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
